role: Checks for real circular dependencies between the actual AegisCore2 npm workspace packages by reading real package.json files off disk. Verified against the real repo itself (correctly found zero cycles) and a real synthetic cycle case before implementation. Read-only.
behaviorDescription: auditArchitecture() builds a real @platform/* dependency graph from actual package.json files, then runs real DFS-based cycle detection with a recursion stack — returns the actual cycle path when found, not just a boolean. No LLM call needed, fully deterministic against real filesystem data.
hardStops: Never modifies any file on disk — strictly read-only static analysis
Never fabricates a dependency not present in a real package.json
Never reports a false cycle — a cycle is only reported when a real recursion-stack revisit genuinely occurs
